race.comment: GYPSY RHYME (3) is hard to knock, missing narrowly fresh before getting the job done impressively last start over 1200m. Fitter again third-up today and she looks a progressive type. Drawn out but that's no issue with her speed and she can get the job done again. DEEP DISCRETION (2) was below her best last time when seventh over 1200m at this track, beaten 3.5 lengths. Yet to miss the placings in two starts over this course and distance. Has the class to figure prominently. PAT'S LAST BANG (7) has been outpointed in stronger races than this recently but this presents as a golden opportunity to bounce back to form. SAFE HUSTLE (8) missed the placings two runs back then didn't do any better last start when in tenth over 1200m at this track. Better suited here though and an improved effort is expected. SIMPLY ROSSO (1) can bounce back to form.
